scope: P8 connected-game personal messaging grants and immutable DM origin
changes: Owner can permanently register a bot identity as a game application type; this asserts no verified publisher or first-party trust.
Authenticated human recipients list, explicitly authorize, toggle, revoke and reauthorize their own revisioned grants. Stale writes fail with409/CONFLICT.
Shared DM transactions enforce grants for sends, edits and attachment completion; disabled/revoked permissions cannot be bypassed through ordinary bot DM routes.
Request-state transition and message insertion share a transaction, so rejected requests leave no empty pending conversation.
Persisted application_id is derived at send time; HTTP history, pins, search and WS retain it, while historical messages are not relabeled. UI and encrypted local search preserve the marker.
Personal exports include only the requester grants; anonymization deletes recipient and retired-bot grants while shared history remains.
